lines.en: Soon you will be paired up with the person who is roughly your equivalent in Eagleton.
April, you'll be with someone named Tinnifer.
And Ron, your guy is also named Ron.
Is that your name, or are you telling me you're finished talking?
Okay, Eagleton Ron, tell me a little about yourself.
Well, I love the outdoors, love nature.
I'm a big believer in environmental conservation, recycling and composting and the like.
I'm a yoga nut, and I'm a nut nut.
And I'm a vegan, of course, slowly working towards full friggin' vegan.
What in God's name is friggin' vegan?
You only eat vegetables that have been thrown out in people's dumpsters.
What is on your foot, sir?
I believe a man's feet should remain uncaged.
Well, uh, Eagleton Ron, we here in Pawnee value loyalty above all else, so would you be opposed to signing an official loyalty pledge to our new town?
Well, as long as that new town were open to the ideals of communal living, where everyone pitches in towards a common good.
In the immortal words of Cat Stevens, if you want to be free, be free.
What in the name of all that is holy is that smell?
I once thought I had a friend.
Then it turned out he was the single worst person I have ever met.
You don't know meat is murder?
It's one of the best songs I've ever written about industrialized beef consumption.
I think it might be time for you to go.
This Ron has a position pretty much locked up, and I don't think we have any room for you in our department.
Tars and Capricorns, they were mixed, do they?
Just remember, Ron, giving it a hate is like drinking salt water.
Leslie, remove this man before I commit an act of violence against him.
Whatever you do, I won't fight back.
Whatever you do, I won't fight back.
